dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: We're still a few herbal varieties short of completing Mr. Yiqing's order. It seems we'll have to send someone to Bubu Pharmacy to buy them...

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: I'm Xuanfu, a very ordinary herb gatherer.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: Feel free to let me know if you need any herbs. I'll do my best to get you some.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: Bubu Pharmacy can be said to be the best infirmary in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: Dr. Baizhu's skills are impeccable, his pharmacy is packed with rare herbs, and the young girl in charge of getting the herbs is extremely nimble.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: If I could attain just a tenth of their skill, I would have no regrets in this life.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you often gather herbs here?

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: Indeed, I am quite familiar with the mountains around here, so feel free to ask if you cannot find your way.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: And I suggest staying away from Yaodie Valley unless you have a specific reason to go there. As far as I know, it is not welcoming to outsiders.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: Honestly, though, I don't know much about Yaodie Valley. I've only heard the village elders mention it.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: According to them, the valley is full of butterflies, and Herblord's abode is hidden deep within.

dialogues.speaker: Xuanfu
dialogues.text: Herblord is fond of peace and quiet, so I haven't attempted to explore the place, and don't know what it's like there.
